fault_confinement_states.name: error active
fault_confinement_states.description: Can take part in bus communication; sends ACTIVE ERROR FLAG (6 dominant bits) on error.

fault_confinement_states.name: error passive
fault_confinement_states.description: Sends PASSIVE ERROR FLAG (6 recessive bits) only; must wait SUSPEND TRANSMISSION (8 recessive bits) before initiating further transmission.

fault_confinement_states.name: bus off
fault_confinement_states.description: Output drivers switched off; no influence on the bus. Recovers to error-active (counters = 0) after 128 occurrences of 11 consecutive recessive bits monitored on the bus.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_BUS_IDLE
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Bus idle (≥ 11 consecutive recessive bits). Pending message waits.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_SOF
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Transmit START OF FRAME (1 dominant bit); all nodes hard-synchronize.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_ARBITRATION
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send IDENTIFIER + RTR bit by bit; monitor bus. Drove recessive but read dominant → LOSE arbitration → switch to receiver.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_DATA
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send DATA FIELD (0..8 bytes, MSB first within each byte).

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_CRC
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send 15-bit CRC SEQUENCE + recessive CRC DELIMITER.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_ACK_SLOT
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Drive recessive on ACK SLOT; sample bus; expect a dominant from at least one receiver.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_EOF
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Drive 7 recessive bits as END OF FRAME.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_SUSPEND
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (error-passive only) Drive 8 recessive SUSPEND TRANSMISSION bits before next transmission.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_BUS_IDLE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Wait for dominant bit (= START OF FRAME).

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_HARD_SYNC
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Hard-synchronize internal bit time to the SOF edge.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_ARBITRATION
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Sample IDENTIFIER + RTR; apply MESSAGE FILTERING locally.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_DATA_COLLECT
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Receive CONTROL + DATA + CRC; resynchronize on each recessive→dominant transition (subject to RJW).

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_ACK_GEN
fsm_hints_receiver.description: If CRC matched, drive dominant during ACK SLOT.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_VALIDATE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: If no error up to the last-but-one bit of EOF, message is valid; deliver to object layer.

synchronization_rules: Only one SYNCHRONIZATION within one bit time is allowed.
An edge is used for SYNCHRONIZATION only if the value detected at the previous SAMPLE POINT differs from the bus value immediately after the edge.
HARD SYNCHRONIZATION is performed on the recessive-to-dominant edge during BUS IDLE (= START OF FRAME).
All other recessive-to-dominant edges (and optionally dominant-to-recessive edges at low bit rates) use RESYNCHRONIZATION.
A node transmitting a dominant bit will not RESYNCHRONIZE on a recessive-to-dominant edge with positive PHASE ERROR (when only recessive-to-dominant edges are used).
arbitration_rule: Bitwise on ARBITRATION FIELD (IDENTIFIER + RTR). Each transmitter compares its driven bit to the monitored bus level. Recessive driven + dominant monitored → arbitration lost; transmitter withdraws (does not send any further bits this frame) and may retry when bus is idle.
anti_deadlock_rule: Multimaster arbitration is non-blocking — winner continues with its frame; losers become receivers. No information is lost. Fault confinement (error-passive / bus-off) prevents a single defective node from blocking the bus.
exit_from_reset_or_wakeup: On wake-up the transfer layer waits for the system's oscillator to stabilize, then waits to synchronize itself to bus activity by checking for 11 consecutive recessive bits before switching bus drivers to 'on-bus'.
default_signal_state_when_bus_free: Bus idle = all nodes drive recessive (= released; pulled to recessive by the physical layer).
wake_up_message_identifier: Special wake-up message uses the dedicated lowest-priority IDENTIFIER 'rrr rrrd rrrr' (r=recessive, d=dominant).
